title: ixdar-cli builds never pass -pl, and the web build stops installing annotations into ~/.m2
description: -pl builds only the listed reactor modules and resolves the others from ~/.m2, which every worktree shares at version 0.0.1. teavm_build installed annotations there (mvn install -pl annotations), and dsl_optimizer built -pl ixdar-app alone, so it compiled against whichever branch last installed annotations; MESH-62 and UI-12 hit a stale jar lacking ENG-33's ToolAnnotation change. Drop -pl from build_state, dsl_optimizer and teavm_build (whose package step already builds dependencies from the reactor with -am), and delete the install step. ixd's own build commands drop -pl in the same change (ai-workspace), and the deny list now refuses mvn -pl.
definition-of-done:
1. No ixdar-cli Maven invocation passes -pl or installs annotations.
2. ixdar-cli build, dsl-optimizer and teavm-build still work.
3. test_cli passes.
testing-plan:
1. uv run python -m unittest ixdar_automation_cli.test_cli.
2. uv run ixdar-cli build in a worktree.
changes-made: Builds no longer select modules: build_state (ensure_build), dsl_optimizer and mesh_viewer (now launched from the repository root) run the whole reactor; teavm_build packages the whole reactor and no longer installs annotations into the local repository. All 15 run profiles in ixdar-app/pom.xml bind their exec to the compile phase (defaultGoal compile), and the two build-level exec:java executions mark their arguments combine.self=override so an active profile's arguments no longer merge into them; new_scene's profile template matches. test_cli: 103 OK. With the IXDAR annotations jar deleted from the local repository, a plain compile and a validate-dsl profile run on a fixture both pass from the root. ai-workspace (same change): ixd's BUILD_COMMAND, the wt new brief and the post-merge rebuild stop selecting modules, and the settings deny list refuses Maven module selection. Web build not run (needs the Java 25 toolchain).

Removed all 15 Maven run profiles from ixdar-app/pom.xml. The 11 *-scene profiles plus game, dungeon-viewer and validate-dsl had no callers (scenes launch from launch.json or run-scene, and ValidateDsl is reached through the mesh/dsl/validate route). mesh-viewer and dsl-optimize now compile through ensure_build and start java on build_state.launch_classpath(), the classpath run-scene already used. With no profile exec arguments left to merge, the two combine.self=override guards are reverted. new-scene loses --maven-profile and _upsert_maven_profile, and .cursor/commands/scenes-new-scene.md and the generated CLI README follow. Checks: test_cli 103 OK; a whole-reactor compile passes; dsl-optimize on hand.dsl against Hand-tri-30k.obj (4 samples) ranks results, similarity 44.1; mesh-viewer --dsl hand screenshots tmp/tool-35-mesh-viewer.png and shuts down. Ixdar/CLAUDE.md is left untouched: its gen-docs region is stale, and its new-scene line still mentions the Maven profile.
review-summary: Ixdar builds always run the whole Maven reactor from the root: ixdar-cli stops selecting modules, the web build stops installing annotations into the shared local repository, and the run profiles bind their exec to compile. A worktree can no longer compile against another branch's stale annotations jar.
